g.text: O
OPEN Qs
"what…?"
A
AFFIRM
"you came!"
R
REFLECT
"sounds torn…"
S
SUMMARISE
MI SPIRIT (PACE!): PARTNERSHIP ("we decide together") · ACCEPTANCE (worth +
autonomy + empathy — COM!) · COMPASSION ("your welfare first") · EVOCATION (draw OUT
their reasons — never install yours!). Guide, don't wrestle — dancing, not boxing.
OARS (exam!): OPEN questions ("what worries you about smoking…?") · AFFIRM ("coming today
took courage!") · REFLECT (double-sided: "part loves the calm, part fears the cough…") ·
SUMMARISE (collect change talk: "so: breathing, kids, money — did I get it…?").
CHANGE TALK (DARN!): DESIRE ("I want…") · ABILITY ("I could…") · REASONS ("because…") ·
NEED ("I must…") → evoke + reflect + praise EVERY spark. Sustain talk ("but I love it…")
— reflect WITHOUT feeding ("and part enjoys it — tell me the other part…").
ROLL WITH RESISTANCE: arguing feeds "no" (righting reflex KILLS change!). Reflect ("you're
not ready — what would need shifting…?"), reframe, emphasise CHOICE ("it's yours — I'm
here whatever you pick"). Freedom stated = defences lowered.
BRIEF MI (5 min!): Ask (permission! "may we talk smoking…?") → Assess (ruler 0–10 + "why
not lower…?") → Advise (permission + plain + THEIR reasons!) → Agree (ONE small step!) →
Arrange (follow-up!). 5As fit ANY clinic queue.
GOALS (SMART!): Specific + Measurable + Achievable + Relevant + Timed ("walk 15 min to
market Mon/Wed/Fri" — not "exercise more"!). ONE goal + confidence ruler ("sure 0–10…?
below 7? shrink it!"). Review + praise + adjust — never scold slips.
RIGHTING REFLEX: the urge to FIX ("you MUST stop!") — triggers "yes but…" + retreat.
Notice the itch, OARS instead. Change argued is change delayed.
LINKS: NUT one-change/counsel · COM funnel/ladder · M05 stages.
MANTRA: "evoke don't install, OARS the sparks, one SMART step."
